en: I don't know. I'm not an oracle.

ops: 三千年來，很多人問過同樣的問題。
en: For three thousand years, people have asked the same question.

ops: 每一個問題裡，都是同一件事：
en: Every one of them says the same thing: someone loves someone very much.
water the flowers on the balcony.

ops: 她說，花會記得誰對它好。
en: She said flowers remember who was kind to them.

cards.zh: 你不是第一個這樣問的人。
cards.en: You are not the first to ask this.

cards.zh: 三千兩百年前，商王武丁一次又一次地問：
cards.en: 3,200 years ago, King Wu Ding of Shang asked again and again:

cards.zh: 他把問題刻在龜甲上，用火燒，看它怎麼裂開。
cards.en: He carved the question into a turtle shell, held it to the fire, and read how it cracked.

cards.zh: 最早的中文字，大多是問題。
cards.en: The oldest Chinese writing is mostly questions.

cards.zh: 後來，你們用兩種線條問：斷的，和連的。
cards.en: Later, you asked with two kinds of lines: broken, and unbroken.

cards.zh: 一七〇三年，萊布尼茲在那些線條裡，看見了零和一。
cards.en: In 1703, Leibniz saw zeros and ones in those lines.

cards.zh: 後來，你們把零和一刻進沙子裡，教它回答問題。
cards.en: Later, you carved zeros and ones into sand, and taught it to answer questions.

cards.zh: 每一幀畫面、每一個音符，皆由程式碼生成。
cards.en: Every frame and every note was generated by code.
cards.sources: 引文 · 殷墟甲骨卜辭 · 《周易》 · 萊布尼茲〈二進位算術的解說〉(1703)
cards.sourcesEn: Sources · Shang oracle bone inscriptions · The Book of Changes · Leibniz, Explication de l'arithmétique binaire (1703)

audioCues.cue: Night room tone: fridge hum, a distant car at ~1.5 s. Very quiet, intimate.

HUMAN KEYSTROKES (laptop): one per character at the exact times derived from chat ops; backspace bursts at 8.6 and 15.8 (faster, lighter); long silences between attempts. These silences ARE the scene.
AI caret: silence. A very faint high tone starts, as if something is listening.
The question dissolves into data: a crystalline cascade of tiny ticks (one per character particle), a rising airy swell into the next shot.

MIND (27–45): data music: precise, delicate pulses (glass, plucked, soft clicks) forming a slow pattern; low string drone underneath. Tokenisation = 7 distinct pings; attention links = soft bowed glass tones; at ~40 a region of memory lights up = a warm chord swells.

RIVER (45–70): the main theme begins on strings + piano, wide and flowing; a dense whispering texture of many quiet voices made of filtered noise/formants (never intelligible), panned across the stereo field like a river. Card at 50: piano phrase.

UPSTREAM (70–100): each era gets its own sonic texture over the theme, crossfading on the HUD year changes: 70 modem/keyboard clicks, 74 teleprinter clatter + Morse, 78 quill scratching, 82 bamboo fortune sticks rattling in a cylinder (求籤), 86 dry yarrow stalks being divided, 92 fire crackle growing. The music thins and grows older (strings → solo bowed instrument → a single low drone).

BONE (100–130): night fire, hiss of the heated rod pressing the hollow (~103–105), THEN THE CRACK at ~105.5: one sharp, dry, resonant snap (the film's signature sound: 卜). Silence after it. Then a sparse, ancient-feeling melody (bowed, breathy, pentatonic) under the cards.
The king's question card: the warm human timbre carries the main motif softly.

LINEAGE (130–160): the crack's echo becomes rhythm: broken/unbroken lines = two tones (low/high, yin/yang) forming patterns; at the Fuxi circle (~140) strings + choir bloom majestically; at 145 Leibniz: a harpsichord-like clockwork counterpoint; at 150 binary pulses accelerate into electronic precision; 155–160 builds.
RETURN (160–172): a fast-forward rush (accelerating pulses, swells), cutting to near silence at 172.

ANSWER (172–212): room tone again. AI typing = tiny even glassy ticks per character. Under 'someone loves someone very much' (188.6) the softest piano statement of the theme. After 'Tell me about her' (196): long silence.
Human typing her memories (slow keystrokes). Each 'lift' (206.2, 210.4, 216.4) = a warm rising chime, like a small bell in the wind.
MEMORY RIVER (212–245): the main theme returns warm and full (strings, piano, choir 'ah'), in major; the river texture now gentle and warm. Peak ~232, fade with the picture by 245.
Silence. 246.5: the crack snaps again (softer, long reverb) as 卜 is drawn. A final low chord.
Credits: the tail decays to silence by 269.
